title: Safe to Market
summary: A trader wants an escort to the next village. The road is no safer than it was.

dialogue.intro: I need a sword between me and that road.
dialogue.reward: Here. Take your share of the profit.
offer: I need a sword between me and that road.
Stay close. If I scream, run toward it.

goals.say: The trader exhales for the first time since leaving.
